info.name: Saffron House
info.tagline: Where every bite tells a royal story from the heart of North India.
info.address:
42, Carter Road, Bandra West
Mumbai, Maharashtra 400050

starters.name: Crispy Paneer Tikka
starters.desc: Cottage cheese marinated in yoghurt and spices, chargrilled in our clay tandoor.

starters.name: Murgh Malai Seekh
starters.desc: Minced chicken kebab with cream, cashew paste, and fragrant cardamom.

starters.name: Dahi Puri Shots
starters.desc: Bite-sized crispy puris filled with spiced yoghurt, tamarind chutney, and sev.

starters.name: Lamb Chops Rogan
starters.desc: Slow-braised Kashmiri lamb chops with robust rogan marinade and mint raita.

starters.name: Aloo Nazakat
starters.desc: Stuffed potato shells with spiced paneer filling, shallow-fried to golden perfection.

starters.name: Prawn Koliwada
starters.desc: Mumbai-style batter-fried prawns tossed with curry leaves and kokum chutney.

mains.name: Dal Makhani
mains.desc: Black lentils slow-cooked overnight with butter, cream, and a hint of fenugreek.

mains.name: Dum Gosht Biryani
mains.desc: Aged basmati layered with slow-cooked mutton, saffron milk, and caramelised onions.

mains.name: Butter Chicken
mains.desc: Tender tandoori chicken simmered in our signature tomato-butter-cream sauce.

mains.name: Shahi Paneer
mains.desc: Royal cottage cheese in a cashew-onion-saffron gravy with gold leaf garnish.

mains.name: Raan-e-Mehra
mains.desc: Our signature whole leg of lamb marinated 24 hours, slow-roasted and served tableside.

mains.name: Saag Aloo
mains.desc: Mustard-leaf saag with spiced golden potatoes, finished with a ghee tempering.

desserts.name: Gulab Jamun Soufflé
desserts.desc: A warm rose-water soufflé inspired by the classic mithai, served with rabri ice cream.

desserts.name: Saffron Panna Cotta
desserts.desc: Italian-inspired panna cotta infused with Kashmiri saffron and pistachio brittle.

desserts.name: Gajar Halwa Tart
desserts.desc: Slow-cooked carrot halwa in a buttery shortcrust shell with cardamom cream.

desserts.name: Kulfi Falooda
desserts.desc: Traditional pistachio kulfi with rose milk, vermicelli, and basil seeds.

drinks.name: Royal Mango Lassi
drinks.desc: Thick Alphonso mango blended with chilled yoghurt and a pinch of cardamom.

drinks.name: Rose Sharbat
drinks.desc: Hand-crafted rose syrup with chilled water, dried rose petals, and lemon.

drinks.name: Masala Chai
drinks.desc: Ginger, cardamom, clove, and cinnamon brew with full-fat milk and jaggery.

drinks.name: Thandai Fizz
drinks.desc: Chilled thandai (almonds, fennel, poppy seeds) topped with sparkling soda.

fastfood.name: Bombay Vada Pav Sliders
fastfood.desc: Mini brioche buns filled with spicy potato fritters and dry garlic chutney.

fastfood.name: Chicken Tikka Wrap
fastfood.desc: Charcoal-grilled chicken rolled in roomali roti with mint chutney.

fastfood.name: Loaded Paneer Nachos
fastfood.desc: Crispy tortilla chips topped with makhani sauce, paneer chunks, and cheese.

carousel.name: Dum Gosht Biryani
carousel.desc: Slow-cooked mutton sealed inside a pot — every grain of rice tells a story.

carousel.name: Butter Chicken
carousel.desc: Our most beloved — tandoori chicken simmered in rich tomato-cream sauce.

carousel.name: Raan-e-Mehra
carousel.desc: Whole leg of lamb marinated 24 hours and slow-roasted — our crown jewel.

carousel.name: Dal Makhani
carousel.desc: Black lentils slow-cooked for 18 hours in butter and cream — pure comfort.

carousel.name: Shahi Paneer
carousel.desc: Royal cottage cheese in a cashew-saffron gravy fit for a Mughal feast.

carousel.name: Murgh Malai Seekh
carousel.desc: Velvety chicken seekh kebab — silky, smoky, and utterly irresistible.

reviews.name: Rahul Sharma
reviews.text: "The Dum Gosht Biryani transported me straight to Lucknow. Every grain of rice was infused with flavour."

reviews.name: Priya Menon
reviews.text: "Celebrated our 10th anniversary here. The Shahi Paneer was the best we've ever had — velvety and perfectly spiced."

reviews.name: Aditya Kumar
reviews.text: "The Raan-e-Mehra was spectacular — falling-off-the-bone tender. A must-try!"
